title: DispatchExhausted
description: An instant search ran for the whole search window and no driver took the load. The search goes on; the shipper is told so they can raise the price, move the pickup or cancel.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, a random UUID stamped by goway-lib-rs when it publishes. Consumers dedupe on it.

created_by.description: The person who posted the load.

seen.description: Drivers the load was offered to so far.

suggested_amount.description: The price GoWay suggests trying next: the current one raised by the configured step.
